text: {"schema_version":1,"verdict":"revise","checked":["intent_match","tradeoff_direction","knob_legality"],"critique":"Intent requires alert immediately but must stay within 1.0 false alarms/hour. Proposed (transformer w3, q0.9, persistence 1) at default replay yields ~0.01/h, OK. However threshold_q=0.9 is allowed; persistence=1 allowed; window=3 allowed. Main issue: policy doesn’t address that “moment something starts” may still miss onset due to 5s reporting granularity; should explicitly use earliest available evidence (persistence=1, window=3) but also consider threshold closer to default if onset timing is critical—revise rationale/knobs to better guarantee early detection without relying on unverified onset behavior."}
